title: Convergence analysis of the Riemannian proximal gradient method with inexact oracle
summary: We extend the notion of an inexact first-order oracle from the Euclidean setting to Riemannian optimization, and conduct a convergence analysis for the Riemannian proximal gradient method equipped with this oracle, which we refer to as RPG-IO. Under mild conditions on the oracle errors, we establish the global convergence of RPG-IO.
